name: io.serverdex/serverdex
title: Serverdex
description: Search Serverdex MCP servers by task, category or exact tool name; install configs and GitHub facts.

tools.name: search_servers
tools.description: Full-text search over the Serverdex directory of MCP servers (names, titles, descriptions). Returns compact rows: slug, name, author, description, category, GitHub stars, links. Use get_server with a slug for install configs.

query.description: Words to search for, e.g. 'postgres', 'calendar', 'web scraping'. Omit to browse.

category.description: Restrict to one category slug (see list_categories).

sort.description: new = newest first (default), name = A–Z, stars = most GitHub stars first.

tools.name: get_server
tools.description: Everything Serverdex knows about one server by slug: description, category, packages (npm/PyPI/Docker), remote endpoints, GitHub facts (stars, license, last push), a README excerpt and ready-to-paste client configs for Claude Desktop / Cursor.

slug.description: The server slug from search_servers or a serverdex.io/server/<slug> URL.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The directory's categories with live server counts and their slugs (for search_servers' category filter).

tools.name: find_servers_by_tool
tools.description: MCP servers that expose a tool with this exact name (e.g. send_email, web_search, create_issue), as read from the live servers by the Serverdex check. Most-starred first, at most 3 per publisher. Returns slug, name, publisher, category, stars, whether it answered the last live check, and how that server describes the tool. Only names shipped by 8+ publishers are indexed; use search_servers for anything else.

name.description: The tool name, lower-case, as the server exposes it: send_email, search, get_weather.

tools.name: get_tool_name
tools.description: What a tool name usually takes across the MCP servers that expose it: parameters with how often each appears (% of servers), its usual type, how often it is required and its usual description; plus how many servers and publishers ship the name. Built from the input schemas the live servers return.

name.description: The tool name, lower-case: search, send_email, get_weather.
